GoalOptions.Label: Secure Investment
GoalOptions.Text: Secure Board approval for continued investment in the AI-driven Cloud Cost Optimization & Governance system. Demonstrate its critical role in achieving significant, sustained cloud spend reductions and operational efficiency, aligning with strategic financial objectives.

GoalOptions.Label: Validate Technical Direction
GoalOptions.Text: Validate the technical direction and architectural soundness of the AI/ML-driven solution with the VP Engineering. Showcase its scalability, accuracy, and robust integration capabilities, ensuring alignment with long-term infrastructure strategy and engineering excellence.

GoalOptions.Label: Showcase ROI
GoalOptions.Text: Clearly articulate the tangible return on investment (ROI) of the AI-driven system to all stakeholders. Highlight the projected 15-25% cost savings and improved resource utilization, demonstrating its direct contribution to the company's profitability and competitive advantage.

GoalOptions.Label: Drive Adoption
GoalOptions.Text: Drive broader adoption and utilization of the AI-driven Cloud Cost Optimization & Governance system across engineering and finance teams. Emphasize its ease of use, automated recommendation application, and the empowerment it provides users in managing multi-cloud environments efficiently.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial & Financial Focus
Criteria: Board approves Q3 budget allocation for system expansion.
Projected 15-25% cloud spend reduction is validated by finance.
Demonstrated clear ROI within 12 months of full deployment.
Competitive advantage in cloud financial management is clearly articulated.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Operational Focus
Criteria: VP Engineering confirms architectural scalability for billions of records daily.
AI model accuracy for anomaly detection exceeds 95% in production.
System integration with all major cloud providers is confirmed robust.
Deployment roadmap and resource requirements are deemed feasible.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Strategic & Governance Focus
Criteria: Board acknowledges system's alignment with long-term cloud strategy.
Governance framework for cost policies is clearly defined and enforceable.
Risk mitigation strategies for automated resource changes are accepted.
System's contribution to sustainable cloud operations is recognized.
